reason: Depressed-spheric means a sphere flattened at the poles, which is oblate.
Diminishing means size decreasing along the organ. Tapered size is a gradient of size.
Easily ruptured means fragile.
Craspedodromous is a venation type where veins run to the margin. 'Ending in teeth' is also said of lobes, sepals and awns, so the word does not mean this venation.
Ensheathing is the same as sheathing.
Flushed red means tinged with red. The existing colour rules treat tinge as the colour.
Flushed with red means tinged with red. It is the same case as R1756.
Forwardly directed is the same as antrorse. It is mostly used for hairs and prickles.
Fringed-ciliate means fringed with cilia.
Granular-glandular means glandular granules. Gland-dotted means dots of glands. The two overlap, but I am not sure they are the same, so reject.
Herblike means herbaceous.
High-conic means tall and conical. It is still conical.
Intermittent means discontinuous. Interrupted is a PATO synonym.
Denticulate means finely toothed, and PATO has no finer class. 'Irregularly' is lost, which is acceptable.
Splitting open irregularly is a form of dehiscence.
Ivory-colored means ivory.
Laciniately is the adverb of laciniate.
Ladderlike is the same as scalariform.
Large-sized means increased size.
Linear-pitted is a form of pitted, which is foveate. The linear arrangement is lost.
Loosely adherent is still adherent. 'Loosely' is lost.
'Mats' means mat-forming only for a plant or shoot. For other parts the word means something else, such as a mat of hairs.
PO_0020139 is a leaf midvein. A midvein of a sepal, bract or petal is a different part.
Narrowing gradually is tapered.
Negation of bitter.
Negation of bulbous.
Echinate means bearing spines or prickles. Not echinate is not spiny.
Furcate means forked. Not furcate is not bifurcated.
Negation of furrowed.
Negation of protruding.
Negation of resinous.
Negation of rotate.
Negation of sinuous.
Not spirally twisted is not torsioned.
Tufted equals fascicled for hairs and clustered organs. For a whole plant, tufted means caespitose, which is a different habit.
Pedately compound is pedate.
Peg-shaped is peg-like.
Pinnately toothed describes teeth arranged pinnately, nearly pinnately lobed. Plain dentated loses this.
A pseudobulb is a swollen stem internode, mostly in orchids. It is not a corm, even though PO lists the word as a synonym.
Resin-blistered means blisters filled with resin. Plain blistered loses the resin.
Reticulately wrinkled is a kind of wrinkled. The net pattern is lost.
Ribbed-scalariform means ladder-like with ribs, which is scalariform.
A rootstock may be a rhizome, a caudex or a woody base. Only some are rhizomes.
Rose-flushed means tinged pink.
Round-lenticular means a round lens shape, which is biconvex.
Scapeless means no scape, a leafless flowering stem. A plant can have a leafy peduncle and still be scapeless, so 'peduncle absent' is wrong.
Schizocarpic means a fruit that is a schizocarp.
Setulose means minutely bristly and ciliolate means minutely fringed. Setose loses both 'minute' and the fringe.
Stout-rhizomatous means having a stout rhizome.
Suffused with purple means tinged purple. It is the same case as the red-flushed rules.
